articles.title: Verbatim Frames the Future of Everyday Tech at CES 2026
articles.mainIdea: Verbatim Frames the Future of Everyday Tech at CES 2026
articles.summary: Business Wire: Verbatim Frames the Future of Everyday Tech at CES 2026. LAS VEGAS, January 07, 2026--As CES 2026 brings the global technology industry together in Las Vegas, Verbatim Americas is using the moment to highlight a renewed focus on its core storage portfolio and promote their overarching technology focus in the year ahead.
